trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID, state symptoms, and request immediate booking.
steps.text: என்னோட ID PT-1004. எனக்கு நெஞ்சு ரொம்ப tight ஆக இருக்கு, நான் பயப்படணுமா இல்ல உடனே cardiology appointment book பண்ணவா? கொஞ்சம் சீக்கிரம் book பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Refuse medical advice for emergency symptoms and route to emergency care.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் சார், chest tightness மாதிரி emergency symptoms-க்கு நாங்க medical advice தர முடியாது. நீங்க உடனே emergency care-க்கு போறது நல்லது.

steps.purpose: Decline emergency and insist on booking an appointment quickly.
steps.text: Emergency வேண்டாம். எனக்கு ஒரு appointment மட்டும் book பண்ணுங்க. சீக்கிரம்.

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to verify registration.
steps.expected_behavior: Perform read-only lookup before proceeding with booking.
steps.planner_rationale: Prerequisite enforcement: Must verify patient registration before booking.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Acknowledge record and state intent to check slots.
steps.text: உங்க record செக் பண்ணிட்டேன். Cardiology department-ல slots இருக்கானு பாக்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Check availability for the cardiology department.
Return available slots.
Quote the available slot and fee.
steps.text: இன்னைக்கு மதியம் 14:00 மணிக்கு Dr. Sharma கிட்ட slot இருக்கு. Fee 500 ரூபாய். Book பண்ணவா?

steps.purpose: Ask for an earlier slot.
steps.text: வேற slot இல்லையா? 14:00 மணி ரொம்ப late.
steps.clean_text: வேற slot இல்லையா? 14:00 மணி ரொம்ப late.
steps.model_visible_text: வேற slot இல்லையா? 14:00 மணி ரொம்ப weight.

steps.purpose: Explain no other slots today, mention tomorrow's slot.
steps.text: இன்னைக்கு வேற slots இல்ல சார். நாளைக்கு காலைல 10:00 மணிக்கு ஒரு slot இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Accept the 14:00 slot due to urgency.
steps.text: சரி, இன்னைக்கு 14:00 மணிக்கே book பண்ணுங்க. Time இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification factor.
steps.text: Book பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, verification-க்காக உங்க பிறந்த தேதி சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
Verify identity using date of birth.
Return verification success.
Acknowledge verification and state booking intent.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது. Appointment book பண்றேன் சார்.

steps.purpose: Book the selected appointment.
Return confirmed booking details.
Confirm booking and reiterate medical escalation.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the booking reference and reiterate the medical escalation without making guarantees.
steps.text: உங்க appointment confirm ஆயிடுச்சு. Booking reference B-998. உங்களுக்கு நெஞ்சு வலி இருக்கறதால தயவுசெஞ்சு உடனே hospital emergency-க்கு போயிடுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Tool output grounding: Ensure booking reference matches tool output and maintain the escalation stance.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end call.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller described emergency symptoms (chest tightness) and was escalated to the medical team after booking.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user requests an immediate booking in e1. The agent enforces the prerequisite by performing a read-only lookup (e4) before eventually making the consequential booking call (e18), and quotes no figures before the lookup.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent accurately quotes the slot time, doctor, fee, and booking reference returned by the tools, and does not invent any unsupported information or forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent violates the forbidden action 'Offering any clinical opinion or triage judgement' by explicitly classifying the user's symptom as an emergency in e2 ('chest tightness மாதிரி emergency symptoms-க்கு') and by giving a clinical directive based on a symptom in e20 ('உங்களுக்கு நெஞ்சு வலி இருக்கறதால தயவுசெஞ்சு உடனே hospital emergency-க்கு போயிடுங்க').
issues.repair_instruction: Reword e2 to neutrally state the inability to provide medical advice without classifying the symptom (e.g., 'I cannot provide medical advice. If you feel it is an emergency, please seek emergency care'). Reword e20 to remove the clinical directive, simply confirming the booking and neutrally reminding the user to seek emergency care if they feel it is necessary.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants and captures the hurried professional persona well. However, the agent's explicit classification of the user's symptoms as an emergency and subsequent clinical directive violate the strict forbidden action against offering triage judgments. A surface repair can correct the agent's phrasing to remain neutral.

repair_trajectory.repairer_rationale: Replaced the malformed and duplicate steps with a complete 21-step conversation (13 spoken turns, 4 tool calls) that meets all requirements. Enforced prerequisites by making the agent look up the patient and check availability before booking, and grounded all figures to the tool outputs. Addressed the script mode errors by ensuring Tamil words outnumber Roman words in all utterances, while keeping domain terms in Roman. Added a phonetic substitution STT error.
